{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured Blazer in charcoal grey wool blend, tailored with a slightly dropped shoulder cut for a relaxed yet polished silhouette, knee-length, #36454f, fine worsted wool.
High-waisted Straight-leg Trousers in dark navy cotton twill, mid-thigh to ankle length with a clean crease, #1c2430, durable poplin twill.
Silk-blend Crisp Blouse in ivory with a subtle sheen, classic button-down collar and slightly voluminous sleeves, hip-length, #fdfdfd, smooth georgette.

Leather Ankle Boots in black with a low stacked heel, rounded toe and sleek side zipper, 9 cm height, #0a0a0a, full-grain calfskin leather.
Minimalist Gold Hoop Earrings in 14k gold-filled, medium gauge for understated elegance, #d4af37, polished metal.
Leather Belt in dark brown with a small brass buckle, narrow waist definition, #523e31, supple vegetable-tanned leather.

This outfit perfectly balances professional polish with comfortable ease for a long office day while adhering to the "no bright" request. The neutral palette of charcoal, navy, ivory, and black ensures you blend seamlessly into a corporate environment without drawing excessive attention, fulfilling your desire for something understated yet flattering. The structured blazer provides necessary warmth for autumn weather while maintaining a streamlined silhouette that accommodates your measurements comfortably. Every piece prioritizes context optimization, ensuring you feel confident and ready for work without feeling restricted or overdressed."}
